description: This file defines the CompileTool class which handles compiling or transforming input files into a specific output format, translating lines with expressions into reverse polish notation (RPN) and generating macro definitions.

classes.name: CompileTool
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to process input files, convert expressions into RPN, and generate output files with macros.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to process the input file, convert expressions line by line into RPN, and output the result.

methods.name: handleOneFsioLine
methods.description: Processes a single line from the input, converting expressions to RPN and formatting as macro definitions.
